My dear [Mme de Witt](/person/423)
You are quite welcome to make any use you please of my [Scripture Readings](/book/87). I have just completed them, though the last volume is not quite out.

You must miss the spring after this severe winter Your En Quarantaine seems to have been a prediction of your winter of nursing. I am glad all is now well.

We have all been having very severe colds, but are quite repaired now except my brother who has been much pulled down. I am expecting [Mary Coleridge](/person/351) here tomorrow. I made her a visit in the autumn in a very pretty house at Ottery, which [her brother](/person/343) has put into repair for her

yours affectionately

C M Yonge
